test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements are correct postulates of Dalton's atomic theory?

A. All matter is made up of atoms. These atoms participate in chemical reactions.

B. Atoms might be created or destroyed during a chemical reaction.

C. Atoms of different elements vary in mass and chemical properties.

D. Compounds are combination of atoms in the ratio of whole or fractional numbers.

E. A compound will always have constant relative number and kind of atoms.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**A, C, E**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dalton's Atomic Theory** was one of the earliest theories to describe the structure and behavior of atoms.
 
• **Statement A:** "All matter is made up of atoms. These atoms participate in chemical reactions" aligns with Dalton's postulate that matter consists of indivisible particles called **atoms**. These atoms are fundamental building blocks and actively participate in chemical reactions, remaining unchanged.
 
• **Statement C:** "Atoms of different elements vary in mass and chemical properties" is correct as Dalton's theory suggested that atoms of each element are unique in their **mass** and **chemical behavior**.
 
• **Statement E:** "A compound will always have constant relative number and kind of atoms" refers to the law of **constant proportions**, which states that a chemical compound always contains its component elements in fixed ratios by mass.
 
• These statements reflect the foundational principles of Dalton's theory, which provided the basis for modern chemistry and atomic models.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Statement B:**__

 __
 
• This statement, "Atoms might be created or destroyed during a chemical reaction," contradicts Dalton's atomic theory. According to his postulates, **atoms cannot be created or destroyed** in chemical reactions; they only rearrange to form new substances.
 
• This concept is in line with the **law of conservation of mass**, which asserts that matter cannot be created or destroyed in a chemical reaction.
 
 
 
• **Statement D:**__
 __
 
• This statement, "Compounds are a combination of atoms in the ratio of whole or fractional numbers," is incorrect. Dalton proposed that atoms combine in **simple whole-number ratios** to form compounds, not fractional ratios.
 
• The presence of fractional numbers would violate Dalton's postulate of the indivisibility and discrete nature of atoms.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Dalton's Atomic Theory:**__
 
 
• It marked the beginning of modern atomic science and provided a scientific explanation for chemical reactions.
 
• The theory laid the groundwork for later discoveries, such as the structure of the atom and the periodic table.
